source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: **[Diseased Influence](vsdata:ability/death-guard.mortarion.diseased-influence)** checks where the enemy stops. Check whether a friendly unit with **DEATH GUARD** is at most 8″ away. The enemy’s move must be either a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), an [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), or a [Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back). If the friendly unit is unengaged and at most 6″ from Mortarion, it can move normally by up to 5″.
